Chapter 926: Chapter 23 Surpassing The Nine Great Supremes (Seeking Subscriptions)

Chapter 926: Chapter 23 Surpassing the Nine Great Supremes (Seeking Subscriptions)

Qingyou Immortal City, Drunken Dream Tower.

As the most renowned place in Qingyou Immortal City and even the entire Qingyou Immortal Domain, the unique Drunken Dream Immortal Brew of Drunken Dream Tower allows Golden Immortals and Jade Immortals to immerse themselves briefly in a crafted beauteous dream.

This immersion is not merely superficial, as it greatly benefits the nurturing of one’s spiritual will and allows one to break free at any time.

Because of this, every day, immortals from all over the thirty-three Immortal Domains specially travel to Drunken Dream Tower.

To taste the legendary Drunken Dream Immortal Brew.

“The Martial Tao cultivation system is truly impressive, opening internal realms, absorbing the essence of the external world, with the physical body serving as the foundation. In many respects, it is in no way inferior to our Immortal Path cultivation system, and perhaps even…”

“Indeed, I have a descendant with innate divine strength and a powerful physique, but with an inadequate Spirit Root. I sent him to cultivate the Martial Tao, and he has now entered the Sixth Stage of Martial Tao…”

“It makes one wonder what kind of figure the Ancestor of Martial Arts, who founded the Martial Tao cultivation system, truly is…”

“Unfortunately, over a thousand years ago, the Ancestor of Martial Arts had held several public lectures. I missed those due to seclusion and never had a chance to meet the Ancestor of Martial Arts in person.”

…

In Drunken Dream Tower, a large number of immortals from all across the Immortal Realm gather, savoring the Drunken Dream Immortal Brew while discussing major events that occurred in the Immortal Realm.

Among the many topics, the one that sparks the most heated discussion is the Martial Tao cultivation system and that outstanding figure, the Ancestor of Martial Arts.

There’s no need to elaborate on the Martial Tao cultivation system; after it spread broadly, it received affirmation from numerous Jade Immortals and was appraised to be on par with the Immortal Path cultivation system.

However, this evaluation clearly underestimated the Martial Tao cultivation system, as those Jade Immortals who made the appraisal were all stalwarts of the Immortal Path with an inherent ‘filter’ toward their own cultivation system.

And the Ancestor of Martial Arts? Over a thousand years of proliferation, the Ancestor of Martial Arts is now universally acknowledged as the third Ancestral Master-level powerhouse of the Immortal Realm and Demon Abyss.

By spreading the Martial Tao cultivation system and single-handedly ending the war between Immortals and Demons, he silenced many disciples of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path lineage…

Although the Ancestor of Martial Arts has not made a move since the war between Immortals and Demons over a thousand years ago, the reaction of the disciples from the Ancestor of the Immortal Path lineage reveals a lot of information.

“It is said that in the Xuantian Immortal Domain, a Martial Arts powerhouse has specifically founded an Immortal City called Kaiyuan Martial City, where many Martial Arts powerhouses converge, including the disciples of the Ancestor of Martial Arts who reside there.”

“I’ve heard about it too. At the inauguration of Kaiyuan Martial City, celestial phenomena emerged, and even the direct disciples of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path lineage went to offer their congratulations.”

“One wonders where the Ancestor of Martial Arts is now.”

The immortals speak with a sense of wistfulness. Many ancient immortals have lived for countless eons and witnessed numerous prodigious powerhouses.

Yet someone like the Ancestor of Martial Arts, who became an Ancestral Master upon emergence—that is beyond the imagination of all immortals.

That is an Ancestral Master.

Since the formation of the Immortal Realm, even including that of the Demon Abyss, there were only two Ancestral Masters; many immortals even believed that a third Ancestral Master-level powerhouse would never emerge.

…

Drunken Dream Tower’s Class A Palace.

This is where Drunken Dream Tower specifically entertains distinguished guests. Only top-level Jade Immortals are admitted.

Lin Yuan is sitting inside. Naturally, the conversations and discussions of the many immortals in Drunken Dream Tower cannot escape his ears.

For over a thousand years, Lin Yuan’s true self and two Primordial Spirits have been dedicated to arduous cultivation and enlightenment of the Tao. Additionally, he also creates avatars to wander the Immortal Realm.

The Lin Yuan sitting in the Class A Great Hall of Drunken Dream Tower at this moment is one such avatar, who came casually upon hearing the fame of the Drunken Dream Immortal Brew.

…

“The evolution pathway of Martial Arts is developing nicely.”

Lin Yuan sits cross-legged, pondering silently.

This could be discerned from the discussions of many immortals within Drunken Dream Tower.

In over a thousand years, the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway has not produced many Martial Arts powerhouses; apart from Lin Yuan, the strongest is still Li Qing.

However, the number of cultivators and the breadth of dissemination of the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway have almost encompassed all thirty-three Immortal Domains.

Lin Yuan is quite satisfied with this. Given the current foundation of the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway, provided that there is enough time, in hundreds of thousands or millions of years, it will be not the slightest bit weaker than the Immortal Path cultivation system, birthing Martial Arts powerhouses of the eleventh order.

Lin Yuan gently closes his eyes, and before him, the vista abruptly turns pitch black, densely dotted with sparkling stars. Each point of starlight symbolizes a Martial Tao cultivator.

At this moment, the multitude of starlight Lin Yuan perceives is vast and stretches beyond the Immortal Realm.

Lin Yuan is not only spreading the Martial Tao in the Immortal Realm. In the three thousand three hundred and thirty-three subordinate worlds like the Spirit Realm, the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway is also being disseminated.

Although the Spirit Realm is far from comparable to the Immortal Realm, and even when all three thousand three hundred and thirty-three subordinate worlds are combined, they do not match the size of a single Immortal Domain in the Immortal Realm.

But a mosquito is still flesh, and to enhance his own ultimate leap in foundation, Lin Yuan will not overlook any opportunity to strengthen himself.

Given enough time, Lin Yuan even plans to spread the Martial Arts in worlds like the Central Divine Continent of the Spirit Realm, a subordinate world of the Spirit Realm with up to a million subordinate worlds.

The same is true for the other three thousand three hundred and thirty-two subordinate worlds of the Immortal Realm.

“Now, the number of beings practicing the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway might even surpass the combined number of practitioners of the nine supreme evolutionary pathways of human civilization.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself internally.

The Immortal Realm alone is comparable to one percent of the Main Universe in size.
